newsitem.title: SPAIN: Foreign investments in Spain rose 21.6 pct in 96.
newsitem.headline: Foreign investments in Spain rose 21.6 pct in 96.

text.p: Foreign direct investment in Spain rose 21.6 percent in 1996 to 2,080.1 billion pesetas, the Commerce and Tourism Ministry said on Wednesday.
Around 58.95 percent of total investment came from European Union countries.
Direct investment from the United States was 23.63 percent.
By sectors, manufacturing absorbed the most at 47.47 percent of the total, followed by the property sector with 18.68 percent.
By regions, foreign direct investment was mostly concentrated in Madrid with 46.31 percent of the total, followed by Barcelona with 24.03 percent of the total.
